subject: Mathematics
source: Original supplementary learning draft aligned to Class 6 Ganita Prakash Chapter 6 (fegp106.pdf), Reprint 2026–27. Verify any school-specific edition before publication.
goals: Calculate perimeter by adding side lengths.
Use rectangle and square area formulas with correct units.
summary: Perimeter measures the total distance around a closed shape. Area measures the surface covered inside it. Perimeter uses linear units such as cm or m, while area uses square units such as cm² or m².

concepts.title: Perimeter
concepts.explanation: Perimeter is the total length of the boundary of a closed figure. Add all side lengths; for a rectangle, opposite sides are equal.
concepts.example: A rectangle of length 8 cm and width 3 cm has perimeter 8+3+8+3 = 22 cm.

concepts.title: Area as covering
concepts.explanation: Area tells how many unit squares cover a flat region without gaps or overlaps. It is measured in square units.
concepts.example: A 4 cm by 3 cm rectangle contains 4 × 3 = 12 unit squares of 1 cm².

concepts.title: Rectangle and square formulas
concepts.explanation: For a rectangle, area = length × width. For a square, area = side × side. A rectangle’s perimeter is 2 × (length + width); a square’s perimeter is 4 × side.
concepts.example: A square with side 5 cm has area 25 cm² and perimeter 20 cm.

concepts.title: Units matter
concepts.explanation: Perimeter is a length, so write units such as cm or m. Area counts squares, so write cm² or m². Convert units before combining measurements.
concepts.example: A floor’s area may be 12 m², while the skirting length around it is measured in metres.

workedExamples.question: Find the perimeter and area of a rectangle 9 cm long and 4 cm wide.
A square has perimeter 32 m. Find its side and area.
steps: Each of the four sides is equal.

practice.question: A square has side 7 cm. Find its perimeter.
A rectangle is 6 m by 5 m. Find its area.
Why is area written in square units?
practice.answer: Because it counts unit squares covering a surface.

practice.question: A rectangle has perimeter 24 cm and length 8 cm. Find its width.
practice.answer: Width = 4 cm. 2(L+W)=24, so L+W=12 and W=12−8=4.
practice.why: Use the perimeter relationship and solve for the missing side.

questions.q: Find the perimeter of a 12 cm by 5 cm rectangle.
A square has area 49 cm². Find its side and perimeter.
Explain why 24 cm and 24 cm² do not mean the same thing.
questions.answer: 24 cm is a length; 24 cm² is an area measured in square centimetres.
